text.A: **Dasar ini terpakai di mana-mana sahaja anda berada.** Kami mematuhi undang-undang perlindungan data UK, dan apabila undang-undang perlindungan data negara tempat anda tinggal juga terpakai, kami mematuhi undang-undang itu juga.
text.B: **Nota alahan dan diet.** Kami menyerahkannya kepada trak bersama pesanan anda dan tidak menggunakannya untuk apa-apa tujuan lain. Kami membuangnya, bersama nama dan butiran hubungan anda, 12 bulan selepas pesanan (lihat seksyen 7).
text.C: **Pemindahan antarabangsa.** Data akaun dan data pesanan anda disimpan dan diproses di United Kingdom. Sesetengah perkara dikendalikan di luarnya: pengekstrakan menu dan balasan automatik WhatsApp, yang menggunakan perkhidmatan Google di Amerika Syarikat; penghantaran mesej WhatsApp, yang dikendalikan oleh Meta di Amerika Syarikat; pembayaran, yang dikendalikan oleh Stripe di Amerika Syarikat; dan pemberitahuan tolak, yang disampaikan oleh Apple dan Google di Amerika Syarikat. Apabila data meninggalkan UK, pemindahan itu dilindungi oleh peraturan kecukupan UK atau oleh International Data Transfer Agreement (Perjanjian Pemindahan Data Antarabangsa) atau Addendum, dan, apabila dikehendaki oleh undang-undang negara anda, oleh perlindungan yang diiktiraf oleh undang-undang itu. Anda boleh meminta daripada kami butiran perlindungan yang terpakai.
text.G:
[Terma Perkhidmatan](/terms) kami terpakai di setiap negara tempat HatchGrab digunakan. Sesetengah negara mempunyai peraturan tambahan. Halaman ini menetapkan peraturan tersebut, satu negara pada satu masa.

Jika sesuatu seksyen di bawah terpakai kepada anda, seksyen itu menjadi sebahagian daripada Terma Perkhidmatan kami. Jika seksyen itu menyatakan sesuatu yang berbeza daripada dokumen tersebut, halaman ini terpakai bagi negara berkenaan.

Jika negara anda tidak disenaraikan, tiada peraturan tambahan: Terma Perkhidmatan terpakai sebagaimana yang ditulis. [Dasar Privasi](/privacy) kami adalah sama di setiap negara.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We comply with UK data protection law, and when the data protection law of the country where you live also applies, we comply with that law too.
back.B: **Allergy and diet notes.** We hand them to the truck together with your order and do not use them for any other purpose. We remove them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: When data leaves the UK, the transfer is protected by the UK adequacy regulations or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum, and, when required by the law of your country, by a safeguard recognised by that law.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under UK data protection law, and the law of the country where you live when it applies, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The law in the place where you live may give you these rights under other names, or additional rights. You also have those rights. / **Making a request.** Send an email to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We will check that the request is genuine before we act on it. You can ask someone else to make the request on your behalf, and we will not treat you differently for making a request. We will answer within one month, or earlier if required by the law of your country. If you ordered from a truck, we may hand your request to that truck, because it is that truck which decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to look at it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove the names, contact details and notes of its customers from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only when allowed by the law in the place where you live, which in some countries means only with your consent. Every email states who it is sent from, contains our postal address and tells you how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop, free of charge and within 10 business days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a truck offer order updates by text message, you will only receive them if you agree, and you can stop them at any time. / **If a problem occurs.** If a breach involving your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will tell you and the regulatory authority as soon as we can when required by law, or help the truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** Tell us first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we greatly appreciate the chance to put things right. You can also complain to the data protection authority in the place where you live. In the UK, that authority is the Information Commissioner's Office (UK Information Commissioner's Office), at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service](/terms) apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have additional rules. This page sets those rules out, one country at a time. / If a section below applies to you, that section becomes part of our Terms of Service. If that section says something different from the said document(s), this page applies for that country. / If your country is not listed, there are no additional rules: the Terms of Service apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) is the same in every country.

notes: G paragraph 2: its old second sentence is kept byte-identical as required; 'dokumen tersebut' (the said document[s]) now refers only to the Terms of Service, which reads naturally in Malay. 'regulator' = pihak berkuasa kawal selia (breach) and pihak berkuasa perlindungan data (complaints, as in the former EEA section); 'breach' = pelanggaran (as in the former Canada/New Zealand sections).
